Here’s a highly advanced, next-level Keras project tailored for your deep expertise: implementing a Classifier‑Free Guided DDPM (denoising diffusion probabilistic model) on CIFAR‑10, enabling controllable high-fidelity image generation with guidance scaling. This project goes far beyond typical classification or simple GAN tasks.

🧠 Project Title

Project Reference: ai‑ml‑ds‑ZlG5eQnTfpY
Filename: classifier_free_guided_ddpm_cifar10.py

📝 Short Description

Train a guided DDPM using classifier‑free diffusion: jointly learn conditional and unconditional noise predictors in a U‑Net architecture on CIFAR‑10. At sampling time, interpolate outputs with a guidance scale to trade off fidelity vs diversity. Implements advanced diffusion theory (keras.io).

🧪 Full Python Code

# classifier_free_guided_ddpm_cifar10.py
import tensorflow as tf
from tensorflow import keras
from tensorflow.keras import layers
import numpy as np

# Hyperparameters
epochs: int = 100
batch_size: int = 128
img_size: int = 32
img_channels: int = 3
num_classes: int = 10
timesteps: int = 1000
guidance_scale: float = 5.0
lr: float = 2e-4

# Dataset load
(x_train, y_train), (_, _) = keras.datasets.cifar10.load_data()
x_train: np.ndarray = (x_train.astype("float32") / 127.5) - 1.0
y_train: np.ndarray = y_train.flatten()

# Sinusoidal positional embeddings
def get_timestep_embedding(t, dim=128):
    half = dim // 2
    emb = np.log(10000) / (half - 1)
    emb = np.exp(np.arange(half) * -emb)
    emb = t[:, None] * emb[None, :]
    emb = np.concatenate([np.sin(emb), np.cos(emb)], axis=1)
    return tf.convert_to_tensor(emb, dtype=tf.float32)

# U-Net backbone
def build_unet():
    img_input = keras.Input((img_size, img_size, img_channels))
    t_input = keras.Input((128,))
    c_input = keras.Input((num_classes,))
    # Timestep & condition embedding
    t_dense = layers.Dense(128, activation="relu")(t_input)
    c_dense = layers.Dense(128, activation="relu")(c_input)
    cond = layers.Concatenate()([t_dense, c_dense])
    # Encoder
    x = layers.Conv2D(64, 3, padding="same", activation="relu")(img_input)
    x = layers.Conv2D(128, 3, strides=2, padding="same", activation="relu")(x)
    # Bottleneck concat time+cond
    cond_map = layers.Dense(img_size//2 * img_size//2 * 128)(cond)
    cond_map = layers.Reshape((img_size//2, img_size//2, 128))(cond_map)
    x = layers.Concatenate()([x, cond_map])
    # Decoder
    x = layers.Conv2DTranspose(128, 3, strides=2, padding="same", activation="relu")(x)
    x = layers.Conv2D(img_channels, 3, padding="same")(x)
    return keras.Model([img_input, t_input, c_input], x)

model = build_unet()
optim = keras.optimizers.Adam(lr)

# Noise scheduler
betas = np.linspace(1e-4, 0.02, timesteps)
alphas = 1 - betas
alpha_cum = np.cumprod(alphas)

@tf.function
def train_step(x, y):
    t = tf.random.uniform([batch_size], 0, timesteps, dtype=tf.int32)
    noise = tf.random.normal(shape=x.shape)
    a_t = tf.gather(alpha_cum, t)
    a_t = tf.reshape(a_t, (-1, 1, 1, 1))
    noisy = tf.sqrt(a_t)*x + tf.sqrt(1-a_t)*noise

    # classifier-free guidance dropout
    mask = tf.cast(tf.random.uniform([batch_size]) < 0.1, tf.int32)
    cond_label = tf.where(mask[...,None], tf.zeros_like(y), y)
    cond_emb = tf.one_hot(cond_label, num_classes)

    with tf.GradientTape() as tape:
        t_emb = get_timestep_embedding(t)
        pred_noise = model([noisy, t_emb, cond_emb], training=True)
        loss = tf.reduce_mean((noise - pred_noise)**2)
    grads = tape.gradient(loss, model.trainable_weights)
    optim.apply_gradients(zip(grads, model.trainable_weights))
    return loss

# Training loop
for epoch in range(epochs):
    idx = np.random.permutation(len(x_train))
    for i in range(0, len(x_train), batch_size):
        batch = idx[i:i+batch_size]
        l = train_step(x_train[batch], y_train[batch])
    print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}, loss: {l:.4f}")

# Sampling with guidance
def sample(class_label: int):
    c = tf.one_hot([class_label], num_classes)
    x = tf.random.normal([1, img_size, img_size, img_channels])
    for t in reversed(range(timesteps)):
        tt = tf.fill([1], t)
        t_emb = get_timestep_embedding(tt)
        uncond = model([x, t_emb, tf.zeros_like(c)], training=False)
        cond = model([x, t_emb, c], training=False)
        noise_pred = uncond + guidance_scale * (cond - uncond)
        a_prev = alpha_cum[t-1] if t > 0 else alpha_cum[0]
        x = (x - (1-alphas[t])**0.5 * noise_pred) / alphas[t]**0.5
        if t>0:
            x += np.sqrt(1 - a_prev) * tf.random.normal(x.shape)
    return tf.clip_by_value((x+1)*127.5, 0, 255)[0]

# Example usage
if __name__ == "__main__":
    img: tf.Tensor = sample(3)  # generate 'cat' from CIFAR10
    keras.preprocessing.image.save_img("cifar_generated_cat.png", img.numpy()/255.)

✅ Example Inputs & Expected Outputs

  • sample(3) → outputs a 32×32 RGB image resembling a CIFAR‑10 “cat”, fidelity increases with guidance_scale.
  • sample(1) → generates a “automobile”.
  • Vary guidance_scale:
    • 0.0 → diverse low-quality samples
    • 5.0 → balanced fidelity/diversity
    • 10.0 → high-quality, less diverse

🔑 Key Learnings

  • Classifier‑Free Guidance: Combines unconditional and conditional noise predictions; guidance-weighted inference (keras.io, medium.com, arxiv.org)
  • DDPM Fundamentals: variance schedule, noise prediction networks (keras.io)
  • Architectural components: U-Net, positional embeddings, conditional U-Net input
  • Sampling dynamics: balancing fidelity vs diversity via guidance_scale
